name: BO7 weapons
description: Black Ops 7 weapons rebuilt from scratch (own models skinned to BO1 skeletons, so BO1 animations drive them): the Grimhawk, a homing flechette rifle; the Siren, a charge weapon whose slow orbs pass through every zombie in their path; and the GDL Havoc, a pump-action launcher whose sticky grenades wait for the aim button. All from the Mystery Box.
